blockers_that_keep_u04.what_would_resolve_it: an operator-stated list of tip accounts, recorded with its source
blockers_that_keep_u04.why: the tip-account set is not declared, and the frozen evidence rule records a tip only against an explicitly declared set. Guessing which addresses are tip accounts would turn an unknown into a number.

blockers_that_keep_u04.what_would_resolve_it: a caller-stated latency assumption, or a measurement of decision-to-landing that this shadow does not and cannot make without submitting
blockers_that_keep_u04.why: the only latency this system measured is its OWN RPC round trip for a backfill request, which is not the latency between a decision and a landed transaction. Reporting one as the other would be a measurement of the wrong thing wearing the right name.

conclusion: U04_cost_inputs_unstated STANDS. Two of the four required inputs remain unavailable, so no P1 hypothetical entry is priced and no entry is proposed.

frozen_rule_finding.under_the_frozen_rule: prioritization fee is UNAVAILABLE for those rows, because the freeze requires both instructions
frozen_rule_finding.why_not_changed_here: that is a change to a frozen rule, and a rule refined after seeing which rows it excluded is a rule chosen by the data. It belongs in a superseding preregistration, not in this run.
